title: Energy in Our Lives
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: Energy in Our Lives Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Identify the Sun as Earth's main source of energy; describe how people and other living things use energy from food, electricity and fuels; describe ways to save energy. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand C: Matter and Energy – Energy in Our Lives)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on energy from the Sun, food, electricity and fuels, and saving energy, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: The Sun gives us light and heat.
key_sub: We get energy from food, and machines use electricity and fuel. We can save energy.
body_html:
How to think about it

Energy makes things move, grow, light up and warm up.

  • The Sun gives Earth light and heat.
  • Food gives us energy to move and grow.
  • Turn off lights to save energy.
Example

Where does our energy come from?

we eat

Answer: food

Example

What does the Sun give us?

warm and bright

Answer: light and heat

Common mistakes

  • Thinking energy only comes from plugs.
  • Thinking the Moon makes its own light.
